column1: # Example venue list for --venue-tiers. It shows the format only: the tiers are an illustration,
# not a ranking endorsed by this tool. Write your own list and record it in your review protocol.
# Columns are separated by TABs. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#   tier            any label you choose (A, B, core, ...); UNLISTED and AMBIGUOUS are reserved
#   venue           the name shown in venue_tier_venue
#                   ways to recognise the venue; give at least one, separate several values with ";"
# Matching order: OpenAlex source ID, ISSN, whole source name (title_exact), then a phrase contained in
# the OpenAlex source name (title_contains, whole words, longest phrase wins). Names ignore case,
# punctuation and accents, and "&" counts as "and". Each ID, ISSN or phrase may appear in one row only.
# Conference papers published in book series (for example Lecture Notes in Computer Science) carry
# the series as their OpenAlex source, so such a conference cannot be recognised by its own name.
# The ISSNs below are taken from the SCImago 2025 snapshot.
